survivalcinema.consent.title: Make a movie of this world?
survivalcinema.consent.body: Survival Cinema can record this game in "%s" and later turn it into a movie: the best moments, cinematic cameras, your voices. Recordings stay on your computer.
survivalcinema.consent.voice_note: Tell your friends their voices will be in the recording.
survivalcinema.error.session: Survival Cinema could not start recording, see the log.
survivalcinema.cinema.title: Shooting the film
survivalcinema.cinema.subtitle: "%s" · %s min
survivalcinema.cinema.setting_up: Placing the camera for clip %s of %s
survivalcinema.cinema.hint_export: Esc: stop after this clip, hold: stop right now
survivalcinema.cinema.confirm.title: Stop shooting?
survivalcinema.cinema.confirm.body: The finished clips are kept, you can continue later.
survivalcinema.cinema.done.title: All clips are shot!
survivalcinema.cinema.stopped.title: Shooting stopped
survivalcinema.cinema.stopped.resume: To continue: pause menu - "Make a film"
survivalcinema.cinema.failed.title: Could not shoot the film
survivalcinema.cinema.failed.encoder: No working video encoder was found (see the log)
survivalcinema.cinema.hint_edit: Esc - stop editing (the clips are kept)
survivalcinema.cinema.confirm.edit_body: The shot clips are kept - you can edit the film later.
survivalcinema.cinema.done.music_note: Minecraft music: YouTube may show a Content ID claim
survivalcinema.cinema.stopped.edit_body: Every clip is shot and kept
survivalcinema.cinema.stopped.edit_resum: To edit it: pause menu - "Make a film"
survivalcinema.setup.title: Make a film
survivalcinema.setup.quality.draft.toolt: Fast: 720p at 30 frames per second. Good for a first look at the film.
survivalcinema.setup.quality.cinema.tool: Beautiful: 1080p at 60 frames per second. Takes a few times longer to shoot.
survivalcinema.setup.music.auto.tooltip: Your tracks from the survivalcinema/music folder, or the game's own music when it is empty.
survivalcinema.setup.music.game.tooltip: Minecraft's soundtrack (C418, Lena Raine...). YouTube may show a Content ID claim.
survivalcinema.setup.music.folder.toolti: Only your own tracks from the survivalcinema/music folder.
survivalcinema.setup.music.off.tooltip: No music: only the game's sounds and your voices.
survivalcinema.setup.estimate: Shooting takes about %s min - you can't play meanwhile
survivalcinema.setup.resume: Finish the last film (%s of %s clips shot)
survivalcinema.setup.resume_edit: Edit the last film (every clip is shot)
survivalcinema.film.error.no_world: Join the world you want a film of first
survivalcinema.film.error.running: A film is already being shot
survivalcinema.film.error.encoder: No working video encoder on this PC (see the log)
survivalcinema.film.error.nothing_record: Nothing is recorded in this world yet - play with recording on
survivalcinema.film.error.nothing_to_fil: Nothing worth filming in the recordings yet - play some more
survivalcinema.film.error.no_unfinished: No unfinished film of this world
survivalcinema.film.error.no_shot: No shot film of this world
survivalcinema.offer.title: The Ender Dragon is defeated!
survivalcinema.offer.body: Make a film of your survival? The best moments, your voices, music and credits - all by itself.
survivalcinema.offer.hint: Or later: pause menu - "Make a film"
survivalcinema.player.title: "%s"
survivalcinema.player.no_sound: No sound device: playing without sound
survivalcinema.player.hint: Space - pause · ←/→ - 5 s · </> - speed · Esc - leave
survivalcinema.player.speed.hint: Playing speed (< and > on the keyboard); voices keep their pitch
survivalcinema.film.intro.subtitle: A survival film
survivalcinema.voice.title: Voices for the film
survivalcinema.voice.subtitle: While this is open, your call and microphone are listened to (nothing is recorded)
survivalcinema.voice.source.auto.tooltip: The game's voice chat, and when your friends are in Discord, Telegram and the like, their call and your microphone too.
survivalcinema.voice.source.voice_chat.t: Only Simple Voice Chat. Calls in Discord and other apps are not recorded.
survivalcinema.voice.source.apps.tooltip: Your call in Discord, Telegram and the like, and your microphone (call apps never play your own voice back to you).
survivalcinema.voice.commentary.tooltip: Record your microphone even without a call: talk over your solo game.
survivalcinema.voice.mic.idle: only in a call or with commentary
survivalcinema.voice.note.tell: Friends in a call see no recording sign: tell them their voices will be in the film.
survivalcinema.voice.note.headphones: Headphones are best: otherwise the microphone hears the game and your friends.
survivalcinema.voice.note.windows: Calls in apps can only be recorded on Windows 11 (and Windows 10 newer than 20348).
survivalcinema.voice.reminder.title: Recording voices from %s
survivalcinema.voice.reminder.body: Tell your friends in %s that the call goes into the film
survivalcinema.settings.title: Survival Cinema Settings
survivalcinema.settings.consent.ask.tool: Ask every time you join "%s" whether to record the game.
survivalcinema.settings.consent.always.t: Every game in "%s" is recorded for the film by itself.
survivalcinema.settings.consent.never.to: Games in "%s" are not recorded. The recording running now is kept.
survivalcinema.settings.voices.tooltip: Record voices in this world: voice chat, a Discord call and the like. Tell your friends.
survivalcinema.settings.afk.tooltip: After this many minutes without input the recording pauses: AFK farms stay out of the film and off the disk. Talking in voice chat keeps it going.
survivalcinema.settings.indicator.toolti: "● REC" in the corner of the screen while recording.
survivalcinema.settings.markers.tooltip: Mark the moments found on Flashback's timeline, so you see them in its editor too.
survivalcinema.settings.length.tooltip: The film's default length. You can change it before every shoot as well.
survivalcinema.sessions.title: What Goes Into the Film
survivalcinema.sessions.summary: The film uses %s of %s recordings · %s of play
survivalcinema.sessions.new.tooltip: Only what was played since the last film.
survivalcinema.sessions.delete.title: Delete the unticked recordings (%s)?
survivalcinema.sessions.delete.body: This frees %s. Deleted recordings can't go into any film. Finished films stay.
survivalcinema.storage.title: Disk Space
survivalcinema.storage.delete_all.toolti: Frees space. Finished films and their clips stay; the next film is made only of what you play from now on.
survivalcinema.storage.delete_all.title: Delete every recording of "%s"?
survivalcinema.storage.delete_all.body: Recordings: %s, frees %s. Finished films stay, but the next film is made only of what you play from now on.
survivalcinema.storage.delete_after.tool: Once a film is ready, the recordings it was made of are deleted. The film and its clips stay. The next film is made only of new games.
survivalcinema.storage.delete_spare.tool: Clips of older films are only needed to edit them again. The films stay. The latest film's clips are kept.
survivalcinema.storage.delete_spare.titl: Delete the clips of older films?
survivalcinema.storage.delete_spare.body: This frees %s. The films stay, but they can't be edited again (with other music, say).
survivalcinema.setup.delete_after: Once the film is ready, its recordings are deleted
survivalcinema.film.error.none_chosen: No recording is ticked: press "Recordings..." and choose what to film
survivalcinema.encoder.crashed.title: The film continues with another encoder
survivalcinema.encoder.crashed: The game stopped while %s was encoding the film, so it won't be used again. Continue the film from the pause menu.
survivalcinema.flashback.unsupported: Flashback %s doesn't fit this version of Survival Cinema. Update Survival Cinema.
survivalcinema.tip.recording.title: Recording for the film
survivalcinema.tip.recording.body: Make the film from the pause menu: the clapperboard button
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.survivalc: Turns your survival world into a movie: finds the best moments, films them with cinematic cameras and keeps your voices. Addon for Flashback.
